entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return this garbage jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A preference issue? Are you kidding me? The issue is that the sizing is a complete lie! I ordered my usual size and this thing is way too tight. I can barely breathe in it. It's clearly the wrong size and I want my money back now. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration when an item doesn't fit as expected. Let me pull up your order. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is... VF78901. You guys better not give me a hard time about this, or I'm plastering this all over social media. I want to speak to a manager if this isn't solved in the next two minutes.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Line Aero Jersey, delivered 14 days ago. I just need to check our policy for you.
Check the policy? There's nothing to check! Just process the return! I'm not waiting around while you read some script.

I understand your urgency. And great news, I've confirmed it. That jersey is a standard item and falls well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you right now. Would you prefer that, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Yes, absolutely. We can either do an exchange for a larger size, or I can email you a prepaid shipping label for a full refund as soon as we receive the item back. The choice is yours.
Okay. Well... that's... fine then. Let's just do the refund. I don't want to risk another wrong size.

Not a problem at all. I have initiated the return process for you. You should receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Alex?
